# dronieapp.com

> Dronie is a cloud-based drone photogrammetry platform that turns aerial imagery into georeferenced orthomosaics, 3D point clouds, DSMs, DTMs, contour maps, and Gaussian splats — faster and cheaper than DroneDeploy or Maps Made Easy. Includes terrain-aware flight planning, fleet telemetry, a verified-pilot marketplace with Stripe Connect payouts, and a public portfolio site for every operator.

## Topics
- Drone photogrammetry (SfM + MVS)
- Orthomosaic, DSM/DTM, point cloud, contour, mesh, Gaussian splat outputs
- Terrain-following flight planning, LAANC airspace, FAA Part 107 compliance
- Fleet management with live telemetry and camera feeds
- Pilot marketplace (Stripe Connect, 1% platform fee)
- Public portfolio sites at dronieapp.com/u/your-name

## Supported drones
DJI Mavic 3 / 3 Pro / 3 Enterprise / 3 Multispectral, Mini 4 Pro, Air 3S, Phantom 4 RTK, Matrice 30 / 350 RTK (Zenmuse P1) / 4E; Autel EVO II Pro V3 and EVO II RTK V3; Parrot Anafi Ai and Anafi USA; senseFly eBee X; Wingtra WingtraOne Gen II; Skydio X10.

## Output formats
GeoTIFF (orthomosaic, DSM, DTM), LAS / LAZ (point cloud), SHP / DXF / KMZ (contours), OBJ / FBX (textured mesh), .ply / .splat / .ksplat (Gaussian splat), PDF flight report.

## Pricing
- Free — 3 projects/month, up to 500 images/project. No credit card.
- Professional — $49/month. Unlimited projects, priority processing, 50 GB storage, Gaussian splat training.
- Enterprise — $149/month. Unlimited images, API access, white-label embeddable viewer, SLA.
- Marketplace — flat 1% platform fee on top of pilot's quoted price.
